description: Capability for the #659 P4 floating co-pilot overlay window. Scoped to the 'overlay' window label only. Grants the core:window controls the /overlay route uses (drag handle, close/hide/show, re-assert always-on-top) plus event listening for the global live-* broadcast. The custom app commands the overlay invokes (get_live_snapshot, live_ask) need no ACL entry — app commands are always permitted.
